Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Circular Alfven wave: full-state refinement Evolve all eight conserved variables and compare circular polarization, including nonzero Bz/vz, against analytic cell means. Assumptions, units and boundaries gamma5/3, periodic[0,1], rho1,p.1,Bx1,amplitude.1, speed1,T1,32/64/128 cells. Initialize/reference conserved analytic cell means; pressure recovered from means differs from constant pointwise pressure. Editorial clarification Educational fixed inputs only. Count HLLD-to-HLLE fallbacks and face reconstruction positivity scaling; no cell floor/clipping/retry. Finite-grid references are not exact solutions; no universal stability, positivity or order guarantee. The observed order is for a 1D aligned wave, not oblique 2D propagation. Adopted numerical method Full-eight-state HLLD fluxes, MC-MUSCL reconstruction and fixed-step Heun.
